description: This bar chart illustrates the point difference for two models, mBERT and XLM-R, across four different hidden layer configurations. The horizontal axis represents the hidden layer configurations, labeled “hidden:[50], linear”, “hidden:[100], ReLU”, “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”, and “hidden:[100], linear”, displayed in a specific order. The vertical axis represents the “% point difference”, with a linear scale ranging from -0.25 to 0.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. For each configuration, there are two bars representing each model; mBERT is represented by a light gray bar, and XLM-R is represented by a dark blue bar. For “hidden:[50], linear”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.08, while the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.08. For “hidden:[100], ReLU”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.12, and the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.12. For “hidden:[50, 50], ReLU”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.18, and the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.18. Finally, for “hidden:[100], linear”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 0.04, and the XLM-R bar reaches approximately -0.16. The bars are arranged in pairs, one next to the other, for each hidden layer configuration, allowing for a visual comparison of the point difference between the two models.
